title: The Kasur Resistance Breaks and the Looting Begins

blocks.text: Once the infiltration turns to open combat, the Khalsa moves rapidly through Kasur with firearms, blades, and close-range strikes. Pathan resistance is broken piecemeal as the Singhs shift from one point of fighting to another before defenders can regroup.

With organized opposition collapsing, the tone of the page changes from assault to sanctioned seizure. Then did the Khalsa order looting and plundering of Kasur, turning victory into a broad confiscation of streets, mansions, markets, stables, and movable wealth.
The page therefore preserves both the fury of the battle and the scale of its aftermath. Kasur is not merely attacked; it is opened up for punitive expropriation by the triumphant Khalsa.
